speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness; to determine the cause, can you tell me if your double vision worsens when you look sideways?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The pattern of double vision worsening with upward/downward gaze and significant fatigability of limb weakness that improves with rest is highly characteristic of Myasthenia Gravis. Do you notice any difficulty swallowing, choking, or speaking slurred words?
